how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-ashenvale-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1043:obj:0: Look for signs of the Scythe of ⟦E1⟧ then return to Jonathan Carevin in Darkshire.
rows.quest:1043:details:0: Your story rings true... I do not entirely understand your motives, but if your business here in ⟦E2⟧ involves ridding the forest of worgen in any number, then I can forgo understanding for results.
rows.quest:1043:details:1: BThere is a mine to the south that has been overrun with worgen... They appeared out of nowhere, but from what we know, that is where they first were found.
rows.quest:1043:details:2: BGo about your business, but I would ask that if you find anything of import, you share it with me. We will accept any aid in our war against evil.
rows.quest:1043:completion:0: It is an interesting story you tell, ⟦1⟧. Though the Carevin family's influence is not large enough that we might find the root of these troubles and finish them once and for all, we will do what we can to contain the worgens' numbers in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1043:completion:1: BAlready I have instructed Calor to make this his first priority.
rows.quest:1044:details:0: We shall rein in the worgen problem, have no worry of that. This evil that your friend introduced to our woods will be contained, and I bear her no ill will for her actions. Strange events are afoot in these times, ⟦2⟧, and the darkness knows no respite.
rows.quest:1044:details:1: BI will keep you no longer. I suspect that there are others that should hear of what you have found in the mines of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1044:completion:0: So this is the fate of Velinde, is it? The high priestess will be disappointed to hear of this, they were good friends before her disappearance. Still, the Scythe of ⟦E1⟧ was surely granted to her as a boon by our goddess, and it is unsettling to me that it has fallen out of her servants' hands.
rows.quest:1044:completion:1: BAnother matter for another time, however. I owe you my thanks in no small amount for what you have accomplished.
rows.quest:1045:obj:0: Kill Ran Bloodtooth and 4 Bloodtooth Guards and return to Krolg near Lake Mystral.
rows.quest:1045:details:0: The night elves are as old as time, but their arrogance destroys their very world. And now it destroys our lives too. But that can no longer be controlled...
rows.quest:1045:details:1: BI blame the elves for much, but we are still responsible for our actions. Even beyond the corruption, we are capable of great evil.
rows.quest:1045:details:2: BRan Bloodtooth is one such evil. Power hungry, lusting... the corruption has only made him stronger. My hatred for the elves burns, but I do not wish ill upon their children, so we must police our own.
rows.quest:1045:completion:0: You have done well, my friend.
rows.quest:1045:completion:1: BThe forest is still tainted, but at least we know we have done a small part to return it to its former glory. If you wish to return to me again, I would enjoy the company of my own kind.
rows.quest:1045:completion:2: BBe well. Perhaps our tribes will meet again under less violent times.
rows.quest:1046:obj:0: Bring Ran Bloodtooth's Skull and Dartol's Rod of Transformation to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.
rows.quest:1046:details:0: Return to your own tribe and let them know of your victory here.
rows.quest:1046:details:1: BShow them your trophy, and bask in the glory...
rows.quest:1046:completion:0: So, this is the skull of the fiercest furbolg threat in ⟦E4⟧?
rows.quest:1046:completion:1: BI am more than pleased with your abilities, ⟦3⟧. The Sentinels cannot thank you enough. I hope we can rely on you again in the future to help our people.
rows.quest:1046:completion:2: BI shall put this skull and Dartol's Rod in a place of reverence for others to see.
rows.quest:1046:completion:3: BTeronis would be proud. Thank you again.
rows.quest:1054:obj:0: Bring Dal Bloodclaw's Skull to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.
rows.quest:1054:details:0: Directly to the north of Astranaar are the Thistlefur furbolg. My scouts report that their numbers have grown greatly over the past few months. If they grow too great, they may find the courage to attack Astranaar directly.
rows.quest:1054:details:1: BKill as many of their kind as you can, but bring me their chieftain's skull as proof that their efforts have been stifled... for now.
rows.quest:1054:details:2: BI shall remain here in Astranaar and await word from you. ⟦E1⟧ be with you.
rows.quest:1054:completion:1: BWe are under constant threat from the furbolg. Hopefully this will keep them at bay for a bit longer.
rows.quest:1055:obj:0: Return to Shael'dryn at the moonwell.
rows.quest:1055:details:0: The rod, now complete, lies in your hands. Shael'dryn will want to hear of your success.
rows.quest:1056:obj:0: ⟦E5⟧ to Keeper Albagorm on Stonetalon Peak.
rows.quest:1056:details:0: The forest spirits tell me you are brave and willing to travel.
rows.quest:1056:details:1: BTo the south, not far from Mystral Lake, there lies a tunnel named The Talondeep Path. Through this tunnel you will come to an area known as Windshear Crag in the ⟦E6⟧. Once there, journey to the southwest past Cragpool Lake and then north, up the steep slope until you reach Stonetalon Peak.
rows.quest:1056:details:2: BThere awaits Keeper Albagorm. Heed his bidding, ⟦6⟧.
rows.quest:1056:completion:0: Alas, you arrive. I see Faldreas has listened to the forest spirits...
rows.quest:1070:obj:0: Find Kaela Shadowspear overlooking the valley entering Windshear Crag in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:1070:details:1: BYou seem to be full of wanderlust by the looks of you. Have you been to the ⟦E6⟧? It is a land plagued by the Venture Co. and other enemies of the night elves.
rows.quest:1070:details:2: BRecently, Sentinel Wolfrunner sent my friend Kaela Shadowspear there to investigate what's happening to the land, but I have yet to hear word back from her. I'm even more concerned because the ⟦E7⟧ sent a gnome mage along with her... a sign of trouble for sure.
rows.quest:1070:details:3: BWould you find her and report back to me?
rows.quest:1070:completion:0: Ah, you've come from ⟦E4⟧ at the behest of Thenysil -- how I miss her, my homeland and friends. She must be doing well with the Sentinels to be sequestering adventurers for other tasks. I'm proud of her.
rows.quest:1070:completion:1: BIt is a pleasure to meet you, ⟦8⟧.
rows.quest:1085:details:0: The situation here in Stonetalon is obviously grave for a night elf and gnome to be working together.
rows.quest:1085:details:1: BThe Venture Co. has devastated these lands and I've spent most of my time putting an end to the destruction.
rows.quest:1085:details:2: BDo not judge Gaxim prematurely; he understands the need for us to work together.
rows.quest:1085:details:3: BIf you wish to aid us, then start by speaking to Gaxim.
rows.quest:1085:details:4: BI'm sorry I cannot send you back to Tara with good news yet. Perhaps soon.
rows.quest:1085:completion:0: Treacherous...treacherous and dangerous, that's what this land is.
rows.quest:1085:completion:1: BBut I'm here to show the night elves that it's a little safer with the help of good ole engineering and a dash of magic.
rows.quest:1085:completion:2: BSee, swearing off magic completely won't help the night elves -- they need it. The world needs it. And with engineering and alchemy to boot, you can't go wrong. The possibilities are endless.
rows.quest:1134:obj:0: Bring 12 Pridewing Venom Sacs to Shindrell Swiftfire in Astranaar.
rows.quest:1134:details:0: We are not in open war with the ⟦E8⟧, but our peace is fragile. We often find their agents moving against us, but they do so covertly.
rows.quest:1134:details:1: BOne such advance was revealed to us from hidden sources in ⟦E9⟧, claiming that the orcs collect venom from the pridewings near Mirkfallon Lake, in the ⟦E6⟧ to the south. Orc assassins then use the venom on their secret death raids against the ⟦E7⟧!
rows.quest:1134:details:2: BIf this is true, then we must stop them, ⟦9⟧. We must deny them their source of venom.
rows.quest:1134:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦10⟧. It saddens me to order the slaughter of creatures who may not willingly aid our enemies, yet it is my duty to do so.
rows.quest:1134:completion:1: BYour heart might weep for the pridewings you slew, my friend, but may your heart then swell in knowing that your allies are safe from the pridewings' venom.
rows.quest:1918:obj:0: Bring the Befouled Water Globe to Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post, ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1918:details:0: The slain elemental has produced an intensely glowing globe of water. The contents of the globe are, at best, disgusting. It would be safe to assume that whatever has befouled the water of Mystral Lake is most likely present in the water of the globe.
rows.quest:1918:details:1: BIt's not exactly common knowledge who might be interested in such a find; perhaps the person who originally sent you out to the lake, Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post, might have an idea.
rows.quest:1918:completion:0: You find a nasty ball of water and decide to bring it to me? Who am I, the ⟦E10⟧ or something?
rows.quest:1918:completion:1: BActually, that does give me an idea... perhaps you do need the ⟦E10⟧ for this. I mean, if it helps clear up the situation at the lake for good, then I'm all for it.
rows.quest:4581:obj:0: Take Shindrell's Note to Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song.
rows.quest:4581:details:0: The druid Kayneth Stillwind sent word to me. He would like a report of the happenings along our coast and in the forests surrounding Astranaar. He fears there is a corruption moving through ⟦E4⟧... and he may be right.
rows.quest:4581:details:1: BHere, take my report to him. You will find him in the shrine of Forest Song, in the Nightsong Woods to the east.
rows.quest:4581:completion:0: Ah, Shindrell's report! Many thanks, ⟦12⟧. Shindrell is a fine sentinel, brave and keen. I must read this for clues of a wickedness I fear is moving through ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:6383:completion:0: There are three legendary creatures that make up the ⟦E4⟧ Hunt; you may seek them and test yourself against their cunning and might. In the process, you will hopefully learn something about yourself. The creatures are: the bear Ursangous, the nightsaber cat Shadumbra, and the hippogryph Sharptalon.
rows.quest:6383:completion:1: BThe creatures of the ⟦E4⟧ Hunt are powerful, and you may find that you'll need aid in bringing them down. If you should best them, bring me proof of your deed.
rows.quest:6441:obj:0: Collect 16 Satyr Horns for Pixel in Splintertree Post.
rows.quest:6441:details:0: Heya! I've been traveling through ⟦E4⟧, heading towards Ratchet, and decided to make a stop here at Splintertree. I'm always looking for an opportunity, and it seems that satyr horns are in high demand in Ratchet these days.
rows.quest:6441:details:1: BAfter asking around here, it seems that the satyrs in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian all have the type of horns I am looking for. I'm no match for those satyrs... but you look like you might be!
rows.quest:6441:details:2: BTell you what, you collect the horns for me and I'll make it worth your time.
rows.quest:6441:completion:0: These are perfect, ⟦13⟧! Thanks for helping me out!
rows.quest:6441:completion:1: BOh, and this is for your time...
rows.quest:6442:obj:0: Bring 20 Wrathtail Heads to Marukai along the Zoram Strand.
rows.quest:6442:details:0: There is evil lurking here along the coast, ⟦14⟧.
rows.quest:6442:details:1: BIt is the resting place of the doomed city of Zoram, long destroyed and submerged beneath the seas. Lost, and nearly forgotten.
rows.quest:6442:details:2: BNow, the naga have returned, and for what reason we do not know. But reason matters little; we must defend the land we have worked so hard to claim as our own.
rows.quest:6442:details:3: BReturn to me with 20 of their heads! Throw the naga back to the depths!
rows.quest:6442:completion:0: We could use more of your kind around here, ⟦15⟧. Thank you for your help.
rows.quest:6462:obj:0: Bring 8 Troll Charms to Mitsuwa at the Zoram'gar Outpost.
rows.quest:6462:details:0: My kinfolk were traveling here with many sacred troll charms, but the Thistlefur furbolgs attacked and killed them before they reached Zoram'gar! Those vile Furbolgs!
rows.quest:6462:details:1: BI miss my brothers and sisters who were killed, but we will meet again in the afterlife. However, their troll charms hold great value in this world. It is an outrage that the furbolgs have them!
rows.quest:6462:details:2: B⟦16⟧, you must retrieve the charms! They are in chests in Thistlefur Hold, a cave at the end of Thistlefur Village, north of Astranaar.
rows.quest:6462:completion:0: You found them! Thank you! Thank you, ⟦17⟧! You do not know how great a thing you have done for me.
rows.quest:6462:completion:1: BA troll without his charm is like an orc without his battle scars...
rows.quest:6482:obj:0: Escort Ruul, then speak with Yama Snowhoof in Splintertree Post.
rows.quest:6482:details:1: B⟦18⟧? You're no furbolg. They are cursed! They thought I was a bear and captured me, and now they starve me! My strength is failing...
rows.quest:6482:details:2: BHelp me escape, then speak with my sister Yama at the Splintertree Post to the east.
rows.quest:6482:completion:0: You found my brother! He was captured by the Thistlefurs? That is terrible news to hear, for although many Furbolgs are noble creatures, the Thistlefurs are corrupt.
rows.quest:6482:completion:1: BThank you for rescuing my brother, ⟦20⟧. I do not want to think of how they treated poor Ruul. He will likely sleep long after this ordeal...
rows.quest:6503:obj:0: Kill 9 ⟦E4⟧ Outrunners, then return to Kuray'bin at Splintertree Outpost.
rows.quest:6503:details:0: We received reports that ⟦E4⟧ outrunners left Silverwing Outpost not long ago, and now sneak near our territories in the forest. We don't want them gathering intelligence on our defenses!
rows.quest:6503:details:1: BSneak through the forests south of our post here and east of the ⟦E7⟧ outpost of Silverwing. Find and slay the outrunners, then return to me.
rows.quest:6503:completion:0: Very good, ⟦21⟧. Your hunting skills are impressive...
rows.quest:6503:completion:1: BThe loss of those outrunners help blind the ⟦E7⟧, and when they lack intelligence they are less likely to launch attacks.
rows.quest:6504:obj:0: Find the 12 missing pages of the Shredder Operating Manual, and put them together to form Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Return the pages to Gurda Ragescar near Splintertree Post.⟦22⟧
rows.quest:6504:details:0: I just picked up this shredder from Ratchet and I was on my way back to the Warsong Lumber Camp, where I am supposed to be on duty. I was given a manual on how to operate the shredder, but on the trip back, a huge gust of wind blew it from my hands. The pages went everywhere, and all I was left with was the cover.
rows.quest:6504:details:1: BThe pages could be just about anywhere by now, I suppose... but I don't know how to use the shredder without them! Will you find them for me?
rows.quest:6504:completion:0: Reading isn't my strong point... but now I'll be able to get back to work! Thanks, ⟦23⟧!
rows.quest:6544:obj:0: Escort Torek on his attack against Silverwing Outpost and Duriel ⟦E11⟧, then report to Ertog Ragetusk at Splintertree Post.
rows.quest:6544:details:1: BMy raiders and I are about to attack the Silverwing Outpost to the west. Our target is its leader, Duriel ⟦E11⟧. Scouts report the outpost is defended heavily with sentinels and warriors. The battle will be glorious!
rows.quest:6544:details:2: BDo you want to share in the glory, ⟦25⟧, and aid us? If so, then when it's over you can report our success to my superior, Ertog Ragetusk in Splintertree.
rows.quest:6544:details:3: BWhat do you say. Are you with us?
rows.quest:6544:completion:0: So Torek's attack was successful! Well done, ⟦26⟧. Night elves are decent foes. A little skinny, but strong and fierce! I'm sure the battle was something to see...
rows.quest:6544:completion:1: BAnd I hope you gained a scar or two!
rows.quest:6571:obj:0: Collect the Warsong Supplies: Warsong Saw Blades, Logging Rope, Warsong Oil, and the Warsong Axe Shipment for Locke Okarr in Splintertree Post.
rows.quest:6571:details:0: We are in short supply of a few items at the Warsong lumber camp!
rows.quest:6571:details:1: BPixel at Splintertree Post has our shipment of saw blades. It'll take a trip to Booty Bay to pick up a crate of axes from Wharfmaster Lozgil.
rows.quest:6571:details:2: BOur shipment of oil and rope will be more difficult. The rope was pilfered by the Thistlefur and Foulweald furbolgs, and the satyrs intercepted the delivery of the oil and are now using it for detestable rituals in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian!
rows.quest:6571:completion:0: Excellent, ⟦27⟧. You've saved me a lot of work!
rows.quest:6571:completion:1: BBut don't think that I'm not grateful!
rows.quest:6621:obj:0: Place Karang's Banner on the Foulweald Totem Mound. Do not let the furbolgs destroy the banner. Defeat Chief Murgut and bring Murgut's Totem to Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar.
rows.quest:6621:details:0: ⟦28⟧, another tribe of Furbolgs, the Foulweald, live southeast of Astranaar. They are not as many as the Thistlefur, but their ferocity poses a future threat. With a show of force, we can remove that threat.
rows.quest:6621:details:1: BTake this banner, go to the Foulweald village and place it on their totem mound. They will try to destroy the banner, but hold your ground until their chief, Murgut, appears to save face for the tribe. Bring me the totem he carries.
rows.quest:6621:details:2: BGather your allies, ⟦29⟧. This is no task for a single ⟦30⟧.
rows.quest:6621:completion:0: Good work, ⟦31⟧. Issuing that challenge to the Foulwealds and defeating their leader sends them a strong message:
rows.quest:6621:completion:1: BThe ⟦E8⟧ is not to be trifled with.
rows.quest:6621:completion:2: BI don't believe that tribe will be giving us much trouble for a long time.
rows.quest:6641:obj:0: Keep Muglash safe as he travels to the brazier. Help him by putting the brazier out, then protect him as you fight against the Naga.
rows.quest:6641:obj:1: BIf you are successful, return to the Zoram'gar Outpost and inform the Warsong Runner of the death of Vorsha the Lasher.
rows.quest:6641:details:0: Vorsha the Lasher... the fiendish hydra that roams the seas...
rows.quest:6641:details:1: BShe has attacked our outpost, each time unprovoked, laying waste to anything that falls in her path.
rows.quest:6641:details:2: BBut I am ready, ⟦32⟧. I have prepared to best the hydra and end these attacks on Zoram'gar.
rows.quest:6641:details:3: BThe naga honor the wicked nature of this beast with a brazier that remains lit on an island just off the coast. I believe that if we put it out, Vorsha will appear in anger.
rows.quest:6641:details:4: BWe will need help, so be sure to bring some strong allies.
rows.quest:6641:completion:0: I have witnessed many naga attacks since I arrived here. It puts my mind at ease that Vorsha will no longer roam freely.
rows.quest:6922:obj:0: Bring the Strange Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:6922:details:0: The defeated water elemental has left behind a strange water globe. You surmise that the object somehow fed the beast energy. Inside the globe, a putrid-looking form of water sloshes about. The globe itself seems impervious to any sort of physical force.
rows.quest:6922:details:1: BIf anyone can make any sense of this item, it would be Je'neu Sancrea of the ⟦E10⟧. He is located at the ⟦E8⟧'s Zoram'gar Outpost in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:6922:completion:0: This... this is quite the find, ⟦34⟧.
rows.quest:6922:completion:1: BYou acquired this from Baron Aquanis in Blackfathom, you say? Baron Aquanis has long been thought of as a corrupted elemental power; this globe will prove what exactly had corrupted him. While it would be no surprise if it turned out to be the Twilight's ⟦E12⟧, our studies will also show how they did it as well.
rows.quest:6922:completion:2: BYou did well in bringing this to me. Please - take this, along with the ⟦E10⟧'s warmest regards.
rows.quest:7863:completion:0: You've certainly begun to prove yourself to us, ⟦35⟧. As a reward, please take this care package! Inside it you'll find rations and bandages that are usable only inside ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:7863:completion:1: BAs you continue to prove yourself inside the Gulch, you'll find that these items will become available to you for purchase. Rations become available when you are Friendly with us, and bandages when you are Honored.
rows.quest:7864:completion:0: You've certainly begun to prove yourself to us, ⟦36⟧. As a reward, please take this care package! Inside it you'll find rations and bandages that are usable only inside ⟦E13⟧.
